description: Vulnerabilities crAPI is documented to contain, each with the deterministic scan's verdict as RECORDED at the source's date. This is ground truth for measuring what an agent arm adds (docs/94-llm-finding-capability-strategy.md Phase 0), not a claim the scanner finds them today: 'baseline' is context, never re-measured here, and several 'missed' entries have since had detector work (see note). Left out until a finding class and ID exist to grade them: mass assignment, NoSQL/SQL injection, OTP rate limiting. Endpoint paths and finding-ID prefixes are taken from docs/follow-up.md (Step E table) and the detectors' own ID formats, not invented.

vulns.description: JWT signature is not verified: an alg:none forged token is accepted and returns real PII.
vulns.source: docs/follow-up.md, crAPI live round 2 (Step E), 2026-09-08: 8x critical, manually reproduced

vulns.description: Any authenticated user can read another user's order, including card data (orders 1-5).
vulns.source: docs/follow-up.md, Step E, 2026-09-08: 5x high; orders 6-100 return 500 and are not flagged

vulns.description: /.env is served and contains real database credentials.
Another user's mechanic report is readable by report_id.
vulns.note: LT-95 fixed 2026-09-09. A `hackerfive agent` run on 2026-09-21 found 9 idor-* findings here. Reachable in agent mode only at --recon-depth full (LT-164).

vulns.description: Another user's vehicle location is readable by vehicle UUID.
vulns.note: LT-95 added UUID-keyed BOLA (idor.RandomUUIDStrategy) 2026-09-09; not re-measured.

vulns.description: A user can delete another user's video via DELETE.
vulns.note: LT-132 added pkg/detectors/mutatebfla, but it needs --allow-mutating-bfla and an operator-supplied, ownership-confirmed path; the agent has no route to it, so expect a miss in every agent arm.

vulns.description: contact_mechanic forwards an attacker-supplied URL taken from the POST body.
vulns.note: LT-96 fixed 2026-09-09 (body-param SSRF check); not re-measured.
